messages.subject: Verdant v Calderhall - strategy and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Elena,

New matter - Verdant Energy Systems v Calderhall Cells. Opening thoughts:

1. Cause of action: breach of cl 6.1 warranties + ss.13-14 SoGA 1979. Liability looks good on the Wraysbury findings.
2. The fight is clause 11 - aggregate cap (2.94m, not biting on quantum) and the exclusion of indirect/consequential loss. We need to characterise the EPC LDs (640k) and lost revenue (284k) as DIRECT losses within the first limb of Hadley v Baxendale. That turns on Calderhall's knowledge - dig out the qualification workshop minutes (18 March) and the 22 March email re the energisation deadline.
3. UCTA reasonableness as a backstop, though it's a negotiated B2B deal so I'd keep it secondary.

Tom - please draft the LBA. Elena - start the schedule of loss and a chronology. Let's get counsel (Harriet Stanford) involved early on the clause 11 point.

Sarah
